## $\bigstar$ The Many Faces of Completeness

All prose

### The Five Characterizations

**LUB**: every nonempty set bounded above has a supremum

**MCT**: every monotone bounded sequence converges

**Nested Intervals**: nested closed intervals have nonempty intersection

**Bolzano-Weierstrass**: every bounded sequence has a convergent subsequence

**Cauchy Completeness**: every Cauchy sequence converges

::: {#thm-completeness-equivalence}
## Characterizations of Completeness
For an ordered field, the following are equivalent: LUB, MCT, Nested Intervals, Bolzano-Weierstrass, and Cauchy completeness.
:::
